claims.summary: City lists the festival on Sunday, Oct. 11, from 11 a.m. to 9 p.m. local time.
City places the festival in the Lakefront and Gentilly area near UNO Lakefront Arena, Franklin Avenue and Leon C. Simon Drive.
City advises of local delays and pedestrians, with NOPD traffic control planned at Franklin Avenue and Leon C. Simon Drive.

interpretation: Official city festival notice for Lakefront/Gentilly. Published hours overlap the Saints game, but stadium travel, staffing and security effects are not established.
